products.name: Grammarly for Education
products.note: Institutional writing support; student data; FERPA compliance; generative AI features

profile_text.body:
Grammarly is a for-profit company founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. Its website describes it as an AI writing assistance platform that provides personalized guidance, text generation, tone suggestions, and proofreading across apps and websites. The company states that it does not sell or monetize user content, provide it for advertising purposes, or allow third-party service providers to train their models on it.

Grammarly offers two tracked products. The first is its core writing and editing tool, which operates broadly across document text to deliver suggestions on grammar, style, and clarity. The second is Grammarly for Education, an institutional product designed for student writing support that includes generative AI features and is described as FERPA-compliant. The company's website also references a partnership with Superhuman, through which writing support and productivity agents are delivered via a product called Superhuman Go. Grammarly claims that organizations deploying its platform save an average of $5,000 per employee per year.

The site's held facts confirm Grammarly holds a profile on theworldofai.org, is classified as a startup, and has no recorded litigation or MCP server presence in the current registry.
